<!-- pr-reviewer: 80f54efd4e386eba4c454f91a4f507ccc2566e15 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review because the PR changes solid-law verification in `crates/sim/src/verify/thread_bore.rs`.

What looks good:
- `crates/sim/src/verify/thread_bore.rs:64-155` adds `exit: Option<f64>` and `ThreadBore::at_exit`. The check keeps the minor-circle band gate and `holds` radial limit, and fails closed when `exit` is non-finite or above `top`.
- `crates/app/src/operation/thread_rims.rs:93-99` sets `exit` from `h.through.then_some(h.floor_z)`. Blind holes keep `exit: None` and keep their existing behavior.
- New tests in `crates/sim/src/verify/thread_bore.rs:206-231`, `crates/app/src/operation/thread_op.rs:295-300`, and `crates/app/tests/thread_mill_rim.rs:380-399` pin flat exits, sloped exits, blind floors, intermediate shelves, lower surfaces, lower parts, and non-finite or inverted `exit` values.
- Non-test code uses no `unwrap()`, `expect()`, or `panic!()`. Layering and crate placement follow `AGENTS.md`.
- `docs/decisions/2655-thread-through-hole-gouge.md` records the decision, dropped options, and change cost.
- All changed files stay under 400 lines (`thread_mill_rim.rs` has 399 lines). No `.cl`, `.nc`, or snapshot `.png` files changed.

Results merged with `upstream/main` (`4a326c7d9`, built locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2699`; no GitHub runner):
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (`RUSTC_WRAPPER= CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1 CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=12`): 313 steps passed, 0 failed (31.5 min).
  - `camcraft-sim`: build, `lib` (191 passed, 0 failed), and all 31 mapped suites passed.
  - `camcraft-motion`: build, `solid_law` (6 passed), and `vertical_arc_entry` (3 passed).
  - `camcraft-app`: build, `lib` (380 passed, 1 ignored), `thread_mill_rim` (13 passed), `thread_mill` (8 passed), `thread_entry` (8 passed), `thread_boss` (12 passed), `thread_passes` (5 passed), `stock_source_holes` (9 passed), `hole_wall_pins` (5 passed), `hole_wall_flats` (5 passed), `coarse_rims` (5 passed), and all other 259 mapped suites passed.
  - `camcraft-ui`: build and 6 mapped suites (`boundary_picks` 7, `edge_loop_pick` 4, `feedback` 7, `machine` 6, `operations` 31, `sinker_setup` 2) passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 12 -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed in 1m 29s with 0 warnings.

Independent mutation checks (run locally on the trial merge, then restored):
1. Disabled `at_exit` in `crates/sim/src/verify/thread_bore.rs:102` (`let at_exit = false;`): `thread_mill_rim::a_detected_through_hole_with_tm0600_verifies_clean_and_posts` failed with 21 `Warning::Gouge` findings. After restoration, `thread_mill_rim` passed (13 passed, 0 failed).
2. Removed the minor-circle lower bound (`p.z >= exit - WALL_BAND`) in `ThreadBore::at_exit` (`crates/sim/src/verify/thread_bore.rs:112-117`): `verify::thread_bore::tests::a_through_hole_exit_face_is_excused_while_blind_and_shelves_are_not` failed (`Some(5.0)` instead of `None`). After restoration, `camcraft-sim --lib` passed (191 passed, 0 failed).
3. Set `exit: Some(h.floor_z)` unconditionally in `crates/app/src/operation/thread_rims.rs:98`: `operation::thread_op::tests::the_thread_grant_reads_the_threads_own_pitch_and_only_over_a_round_wall` failed (`Some(-10.0)` instead of `None`). After restoration, the test passed (1 passed, 0 failed).

Requested before merge:
None.

Notes:
- This review did not run the `batch` gate, the `release` gate, or ignored heavy tests.
- `crates/app/tests/thread_mill_rim.rs` is 399 lines long. Future tests should split out a helper or new suite to stay under 400 lines.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
